title: <Configure /> with react-instantsearch-hooks-router-nextjs triggers double onStateChange
body:
### 🐛 Current behavior

When there's a <Configure /> component being used, making updates to any of the algolia states causes onStateChange to be called twice. Once with the configure object, second time without.

First console log of `uiState`:

```
{
instant_search: Object
      configure: Object
           hitsPerPage: 30
      query: "12"
}

```

Second console log of `uiState`:

```
{
instant_search: Object
      query: "12"
}
```

### 🔍 Steps to reproduce

1. Add <Configure /> as a children under <InstantSearch />. Add any configuration to <Configure />, in my case I used `hitsPerPage`
2. Add custom `onStateChange` handler. Add a console log to observe `uiState`.
3. Trigger `onStateChange` by making updates to any of the algolia components (Hierarchical Menu, etc)
4. Observe the two console logs being printed.

### Live reproduction

https://codesandbox.io/s/epic-euler-k14dg9?file=/pages/index.tsx:2035-2048

### 💭 Expected behavior

`onStateChange` should only be called once, and always with configure object. The extra state change is causing unexpected re-renders throughout the application. Thank you.

### Package version

react-instantsearch-hooks-router-nextjs: 6.40.0, react-instantsearch-hooks-web: 6.38.3, react-instantsearch-hooks-server: 6.39.2
